meta.title: Calgary community district boundaries (simplified, SVG-ready)
meta.source: The City of Calgary - Community District Boundaries (Open Calgary dataset surr-xmvs)
meta.quadrant_source: The City of Calgary - Parcel Address (Open Calgary dataset 9zvu-p8uz), field street_quad; quadrant = majority street quadrant of official address points inside each community
meta.licence: Open Government Licence - City of Calgary (version 2.1)
meta.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.

projection.formula: x = (lon - lon0) * cos_lat0 * units_per_degree_lat + x_offset; y = (lat0 - lat) * units_per_degree_lat + y_offset

meta.simplification: topology-preserving Douglas-Peucker on shared arcs, tolerance 0.9 units; coords rounded to 0.1
meta.path_format: absolute SVG path: M x y L x y x y ... Z (implicit repeated lineto); one subpath per polygon part

fields.name: community name, title case (City data is upper case; converted, e.g. McKenzie Towne, MacEwan Glen, St. Andrews Heights)
fields.quadrant: NE/NW/SE/SW by address majority (Calgary has no CENTRE address quadrant)
fields.quadrant_mix: present when a community straddles quadrants (share >= 10%)
fields.sector: City planning sector: CENTRE, NORTH, NORTHEAST, NORTHWEST, EAST, SOUTH, SOUTHEAST, WEST (null for Fish Creek Park)
fields.cls: residential | industrial | park | residual (residual = unnamed sub-areas, background only, no label)
fields.label: [x,y] pole of inaccessibility, verified inside polygon
fields.label_room: radius (units) of largest circle around label inside polygon - use to scale/hide labels
fields.addresses: number of official address points inside (rough density; 0 for no addresses)

notes: Sector CENTRE (inner city incl. Beltline, Downtown) is NOT a quadrant; each centre community gets its real address quadrant, e.g. Beltline SW with SE share in quadrant_mix.
Industrial, park and residual polygons are included for a complete background; suggest faint fill and no label for cls != residential.
Boundaries are for illustration only; not survey-accurate after simplification.
Privacy: place kitchens at community label points (or jittered within the polygon), never at exact home addresses.
